description:
SBrowserX v1.3.6 — Independent Clone Fix, Full Backup v2, Long-Press Home & Icon Choice:
• 100% Standalone Clone (Zero Crash Without Stock Browser): Fixed the startup crash when original Samsung Internet is uninstalled (tested on both Samsung Galaxy and OnePlus devices), and added full runtime package-name rebinding so arbitrary custom package names work cleanly across all settings screens.
• Complete Backup & Restore (v2, backward-compatible with v1): Full JSON backup now exports and restores all SBrowserX settings AND all stock Samsung Internet preferences (toolbar buttons, More menu layout, address bar position, layout mode, dark mode, homepage, etc.) with cross-package portability, plus embedded bookmarks, stock Quick Access shortcuts, and local Start Page wallpaper.
• Long-Press Home Button: Added a toggle in both SBrowserX Settings and 'Layout and menu' — holding the Home icon (~500 ms) closes all background tabs and opens or reloads the active Start Page from any page.
• Launcher Icon Choice: Added an 'App icon' option inside 'Change package and app name' to choose between the SBrowserX X logo (default) and the original Samsung Internet icon, plus improved app naming in Share sheets.
• About SBrowserX Card: Added an official version and GitHub/Morphe source section at the bottom of SBrowserX Settings.

RU — SBrowserX v1.3.6 (Полная независимость клона, полный бэкап v2, долгий тап по «Домой» и выбор иконки):
• Полная независимость от оригинального браузера: исправлен вылет при удалении стокового Samsung Internet (подтверждено на Samsung и OnePlus), а также исправлена работа всех экранов настроек при выборе любого произвольного имени пакета.
• Полный бэкап и восстановление (формат v2, совместим со старыми копиями): теперь JSON-бэкап сохраняет и восстанавливает не только настройки SBrowserX, но и абсолютно все штатные настройки Samsung Internet (панель инструментов, меню доп. опций, положение адресной строки, макет, тему, домашнюю страницу и т.д.), а также закладки, ярлыки Быстрого доступа и локальные обои стартовой страницы.
• Долгий тап по кнопке «Домой» (🏠): добавлен тумблер в Настройках SBrowserX и продублирован в «Макет и меню» — удержание значка «Домой» (~500 мс) закрывает все фоновые вкладки и открывает или перезагружает стартовую страницу с любого экрана.
• Выбор иконки приложения: в патче «Change package and app name» появилась опция выбора между иконкой SBrowserX с логотипом X (по умолчанию) и оригинальной иконкой Samsung Internet.
• Блок «О SBrowserX»: добавлена карточка с версией сборки и ссылками на официальный GitHub и источник Morphe внизу настроек SBrowserX.

patches.name: AMOLED Black & Bottom Bar Transparency
patches.description: Adds adjustable toolbar and bottom bar transparency with frosted-glass blur and pure AMOLED black mode for the browser interface.

patches.name: Auto-close unused tabs: After 1 day
patches.description: Adds an 'After 1 day' option to the Auto-close unused tabs setting.

patches.name: Block third-party cookies by default
patches.description: Blocks third-party cookies by default across all websites, with an option to re-enable them in Settings.

patches.name: Built-in Google Translate engine
patches.description: Adds a built-in page translation engine with automatic translation and quick language settings.

patches.name: Change package and app name
patches.description: Changes the package name, custom permissions, provider authorities, internal content:// URIs, UriMatcher rules, app display name, and launcher icon (SBrowserX X logo or original Samsung Internet icon) so SBrowserX runs cleanly alongside or independently of stock Samsung Internet.

options.description: Custom Android package name for the patched browser.
Custom launcher display name for the patched browser.
Choose between the SBrowserX icon with the X logo (default) or the original Samsung Internet icon.

patches.name: Disable Update Prompts & Badges
patches.description: Hides store update prompts, banners, and update badges.

patches.name: External downloader support
patches.description: Sends file, image, video, and link downloads to your chosen external download manager.

patches.name: Remove 99-Tab Limit
patches.description: Removes the 99-tab limit so you can keep thousands of open tabs.

patches.name: Remove telemetry, promotions & updates
patches.description: Removes built-in analytics, promotional banners, shopping ads, and background update checks while keeping website notifications working.

patches.name: SBrowserX Settings, Extensions & Privacy Core
patches.description: Adds SBrowserX settings hub and mirrors all toggles natively in-place across Samsung Internet's settings sections.

patches.name: Third-Party Autofill Support
patches.description: Enables native Android Autofill (Bitwarden, Gboard inline suggestions), removes Samsung Pass prompts, and unlocks local credit cards without Knox.

patches.name: Unified Dark Mode & True AMOLED Websites
patches.description: Synchronizes website dark mode with the browser theme, removes dim overlays, and applies pure AMOLED black backgrounds when enabled.

patches.name: Unlock Chrome Web Store & Extensions
patches.description: Enables extension support, unlocks the Chrome Web Store, and allows installing and keeping third-party extensions.

patches.name: Unlock Compact Layout
patches.description: Unlocks the compact floating toolbar layout, smooths scrolling behavior, and lets you customize the extra toolbar button.

patches.name: Unlock Debug settings menu
patches.description: Reveals the hidden Debug settings menu inside browser Settings.

repoDescription: Supercharged Samsung Internet (Morphe patches) — Chrome Web Store extensions on any Android 11+, AMOLED Black & glass UI, native Bitwarden autofill, Gemini AI summaries, Google Translate, zero telemet
